headline: Oil Prices Rise Following Yemen Fighting and Attack on Saudi Refinery
summary: Crude oil prices surged following fresh clashes in Yemen and an attack targeting a refinery in Saudi Arabia. Tensions in the Middle East disrupted regional shipping and raised supply disruption concerns.
why: Saudi Arabia is one of the world's largest exporters of crude oil, and geopolitical supply disruptions in the Middle East heavily influence global energy markets and inflation trends.
why_moved: Military attacks on energy infrastructure and rising regional conflicts threaten global crude supplies, driving immediate risk premiums into energy futures.
